summary: Westravelle Analytical service catalogue (QA-approved, June 2025, group template): ICH chamber programme, stability pulls, assay and related-substances method validation and HPLC method qualification, with sample requirements, storage options, turnaround bands and reporting boundaries.

title_block.title: ANALYTICAL AND STABILITY SERVICES
title_block.subtitle: Service catalogue 2025
lines: Westravelle Analytical Ltd, a Tarnovell company, York

blocks.p: 1.1 Westravelle provides analytical chemistry and stability testing for small-molecule drug substances and products from early development to registration batches. 1.2 Work is performed in numbered protocols with batch and storage details recorded at every step.
2.1 All chambers are mapped annually and monitored continuously; excursions are recorded as deviation notes.

list: 3.1 Pulls within ±7 days of the nominal date (±14 days after 12 months)
3.2 Tests by protocol: appearance, assay, related substances, water, dissolution
3.3 Data summary issued within 15 working days of each pull
4.1 Assay and related-substances validation to ICH Q2: specificity, linearity, range, accuracy, precision, LOQ, robustness
4.2 HPLC method qualification for early-phase work: reduced set agreed per protocol
4.3 Method transfer from client laboratories with comparative testing
5.1 Stability lots in final packaging, with batch certificate
5.2 Reference standards and impurity markers with certificates
5.3 Quantities calculated per protocol plus 10% contingency

blocks.p: 6.1 Interim reports at agreed time points; final reports with trend tables and plots against specification. 6.2 Conclusions stay within the tested interval; shelf-life proposals are the client's decision.
7.1 Formulation support is available from Durnesswick Laboratories and DMPK from Merrivoss Bioanalysis, both Tarnovell companies. Ask your Westravelle contact for a joint proposal.
